title: Highly selective catalytic pathway utilizing metal oxide nanoparticles to produce formic acid through methanol oxidation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,22076-22085
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06524G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mina Arshad, Iram Mahmood, Ali Sarosh, Asim Umer, Muhammad Athar, Mahboob Ahmed Aadil
MoO3, Fe2O3, TiO2 and V2O5 nanocatalysts were prepared through sol–gel, solvothermal, reflux condensation and ball milling techniques, respectively, and their efficacy in formic acid production via methanol oxidation was assessed.
